thread:
Maya (Collections): Ping — VegaStack invoice INV-2026-442 (acct VS-998) is 18 days past due. Sent dunning notice yesterday, no payment yet. Customer is disputing an overage charge. Need proposal: payment plan or escalate to legal?
Sam (Acct Exec): FYI I was on a call with Ravi this morning. They saw a huge BI job on 3/11 that spiked tokens. Claim misconfiguration not product issue. They want to dispute ~$24k of the $31k bill.
Ravi (VegaStack Billing): Confirm — we ran an ad-hoc export and it blew up usage. We accept some responsibility but we also had unexpected API throttles which worsened retry behavior. Can we do a short payment plan while we reconcile? Propose: 50% now, remainder in two equal installments over 60 days.
Maya (Collections): That could work operationally but we need Finance sign-off. Also need a guarantee (ACH) and signed payment plan. Any legal flags?
Priya (Legal): We can approve a 3-part plan if the customer signs our standard payment plan addendum and we insert a "no dispute" clause for the portion they agree to pay now. Also add late fee waiver for 30 days as exception. I'll prepare the doc if Finance ok.
Lena (Finance Ops): We prefer 60% now, 40% over 30 days (two installments). We can't leave >30% outstanding for long due to revenue recognition. However, given it's first-time overage dispute and account history is good, ok to soften. Require ACH or credit card auth on file.
Sam (Acct Exec): I can get ACH details today. They asked to see revised invoice and a schedule, and confirmation we won't throttle during the plan.
Maya (Collections): We need a small set of actions: 1) Generate updated invoice with plan lines + plan ID 2) Get signed addendum from Priya 3) Capture ACH or CC auth 4) Hold escalation to legal unless missed payment. I'll draft payment schedule text.
Maya (Collections): Draft payment schedule: 
```
Invoice: INV-2026-442 (total $31,120)
Payment 1 (due within 5 business days): $18,672 (60%)
Payment 2 (30 days after P1): $6,224 (20%)
Payment 3 (60 days after P1): $6,224 (20%)
Failure to pay any installment allows Redwood to resume collection activity and suspend API keys after 5 days past due.
```
Ravi (VegaStack Billing): That schedule is workable. We'll send ACH form and have our CFO sign the addendum. Can you email updated invoice + addendum to billing@vegastack.com?
Maya (Collections): Sending now — will attach the addendum from Priya once drafted.
billing-bot: Updated invoice PDF available: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-442.pdf (status: past_due)
Priya (Legal): Uploaded addendum draft to the thread and to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/vegastack-payment-plan-draft (please review). Clause highlights: 1) payment schedule, 2) waiver for late fees for first missed payment (one-time), 3) no dispute for paid portions.
Lena (Finance Ops): Approved on our side. No interest, no late fee for first 30 days. Collections to confirm receipt of ACH before marking first installment paid.
Sam (Acct Exec): I'll update the customer and request CFO signature & ACH. ETA EOD today.
Maya (Collections): I'll hold off on escalating to legal or sending to collections if first payment comes through within 5 business days and signed addendum is returned. If we don't see payment by 1782045600 (48h), we'll mark for escalation.
Ravi (VegaStack Billing): Understood, I'll push for same-day. Appreciate the flexibility.
Maya (Collections): Created support ticket SF-2347 and assigned to Collections. Also linking to accounting entry request (#AR-442).
Maya (Collections): Quick note — please confirm payment method and last 4 of CC/ACH here when provided. Do not paste full account numbers.
Sam (Acct Exec): Customer provided ACH last4: 6789 and signed addendum attached to email. I'll post confirmation when payment clears. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Payment attempt recorded: $18,672 via ACH last4 6789 — pending (txn 0x9f12).
Maya (Collections): Marking thread resolved for now. Will reopen if payment fails. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
